changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: One Paternity Leave policy for every organization that has none (#838): male employees, 7 days credited in full once the employee qualifies, supporting document required, the reporting-manager chain like every other type. Keyed on the organization plus the PL code or the policy name, so an organization that already declared paternity leave under either is left exactly as it configured it, and a rerun inserts nothing. Mirrors LeavePolicyDefaultsSeeder, which does the same for organizations created from now on. No other policy is touched: a Maternity "Applies To" value is the organization's own data entry.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO leave_policy ( organization_id, leave_type_code, leave_type_name, description, annual_quota, min_days_per_request, advance_notice_days, requires_attachment, applicable_genders, min_service_months, allow_half_day, is_paid, is_active, multi_level_approval_enabled, display_order, accrual_method, weekend_holiday_treatment, approver_role, supporting_document_note, created_at, updated_at) SELECT o.id, 'PL', 'Paternity Leave', 'Leave for a father around the birth of a child.', 7, 0.5, 0, true, 'MALE', 0, false, true, true, true, 4, 'IN_FULL_ON_QUALIFYING', 'CHARGE_ALL_DAYS', 'REPORTING_MANAGER', 'Birth certificate or hospital discharge summary', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM organization o WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leave_policy lp WHERE lp.organization_id = o.id AND (lp.leave_type_code = 'PL' OR lp.leave_type_name = 'Paternity Leave'))
